q: An upward pulse is reflected from the end of a rope that is tied firmly to a wall. In which direction does the displacement of the reflected pulse point?
a: Downwards: from a fixed end the pulse is reflected inverted, because the end does not move and the wall pulls the rope down.

q: From which line are the angle of incidence and the angle of reflection measured, and what is the angle of reflection when the ray makes an angle of $25^\circ$ with the surface of the wall?
a: Both are measured from the normal of the surface. The angle of incidence is $90^\circ - 25^\circ = 65^\circ$, so the angle of reflection is also $65^\circ$.
